Club: Robotics.description:
🤖 You are a member of the U.A. Robotics club.

🗓️ It meets after classes on Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, in the Development Studio's club bench.
🤝 Mei Hatsume runs it; Power Loader is the advisor.
📈 Grants: Support Engineering +5. Practice counts as training.

Say "I quit the club" to leave it.
Club: Robotics.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a member of the U.A. Robotics club, run by Mei Hatsume with Power Loader as advisor; it meets after classes on Tuesday, Thursday, Friday in the Development Studio's club bench. The lead and members know they are a member (never ask them to sign up again). Going to practice is the player's choice each time; a missed practice is fine, a habit of missing gets one honest word from the lead. Club time is real time: an afternoon at the club is an afternoon not spent elsewhere.
